tools.name: catalogmachine_list_products
tools.description: List products with all fields, variants and collections. Filter by category or collection. Catalog Machine API: GET /products.

tools.name: catalogmachine_get_product
tools.description: Get one product by its Code, with all fields and variants. Catalog Machine API: GET /products/{code}.

tools.name: catalogmachine_update_product
tools.description: WRITE. Change fields of one product. The tool reads the product, merges your `fields` over it, and sends the full record back (the API needs the whole structure). Top-level keys only, for example Name, Price, Description. Variants and Collections replace the old list if you pass them. Catalog Machin

tools.name: catalogmachine_list_categories
tools.description: List product categories with their field definitions. Catalog Machine API: GET /categories.

tools.name: catalogmachine_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (open orders by default), with customer and line items. Filter by status. Catalog Machine API: GET /orders.

tools.name: catalogmachine_list_catalogs
tools.description: List catalogs with permalink, status, privacy and the HTML and PDF links. Catalog Machine API: GET /catalogs.

tools.name: catalogmachine_rebuild_catalog
tools.description: WRITE. Start a rebuild of the catalog PDF by permalink. Returns a JobId: check it with catalogmachine_get_catalog_job. Catalog Machine API: GET /catalogs/{permalink}/rebuild.

tools.name: catalogmachine_get_catalog_job
tools.description: Get the status, errors and warnings of a catalog rebuild job. Catalog Machine API: GET /jobs/catalogs/{jobId}.

tools.name: catalogmachine_get_import_job
tools.description: Get the status of the last Shopify import job (`shopify`) or CSV import job (`csv`). Catalog Machine API: GET /jobs/import/shopify-import or /jobs/import/csv-import.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "catalogmachine_get_product" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "catalogmachine_update_product" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: catalogmachine_update_product, catalogmachine_list_catalogs · Private data: catalogmachine_update_product · Public sink: catalogmachine_update_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: catalogmachine_update_product, catalogmachine_list_catalogs · Private data: catalogmachine_update_product · Public sink: catalogmachine_update_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
